premises.name: QFORM-DEPENDENT-SQUARE-SMOOTHING-v1
premises.scope: R has density <=M; conditional shifted-square variable has density <=1; no independence between R and shifted variable required

new_results.statement: If an original-coordinate physical bipartite block [[0,B],[B^T,0]] occurs, with arbitrary conditioned outside couplings, then ||p_Q||_infinity <= 2 sqrt(e pi)/sqrt(sigma_1(B)sigma_2(B)).
For A=[[0,B],[B^T,0]], at least three eigenvalues |lambda|>=1 forces sigma_2(B)>=1 and hence ||p_Q||_infinity <= 2 sqrt(e pi).

After one original-coordinate pivot a and Schur complement S, if S has a physical bipartite cross block B with zero within-block quadratic terms, then ||p_Q||_infinity <= 4(2 e pi)^(1/4)/(j^(1/4) sqrt(|a| g_j(2B))).

unresolved_implication: Derive from the bare hypothesis of at least three eigenvalues |lambda|>=1 either a dimension-free physical bipartite rank-two scale (possibly after one physical Schur pivot) or an aggregate Banks-type payment over many weak cross blocks.
next_step: Give B19/B20 and coordinate-structure workers the exact Banks cross-block criterion; attack spectral-to-original-coordinate extraction/aggregation without selecting a dimension-degrading fixed minor.
